title: Fema / RBI | Bombay HC Quashes Wilful Defaulter Declaration for Failure to Pass Reasoned Order
description: Fema / RBIBombay High Court quashed Bank of Maharashtras wilful defaulter declaration for non-compliance with RBI Guidelines and mandatory procedural safeguards.The post Bombay HC Quashes Wilful Defaulter Declaration for Failure to Pass Reasoned Order appeared first on TaxGuru.
